changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetResult') BEGIN
CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionAssetResult]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [OwningAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EvaluatedAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NULL, [RunDate] [datetime], [PassCount] [int], [FailCount] [int], [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionAssetResult] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) )
END
ALTER TABLE API.ExecutionAssetResult ALTER COLUMN [OwningAssetUid] uniqueidentifier null
